units.source_text: 这葫芦里到底卖的是什么药哇！

en.t: What on earth is he up to here!

units.source_text: 现在谁有心思去听这种不痛不痒的啰嗦话呀……

en.t: Who has the patience now to listen to this pointless, lukewarm chatter...

units.source_text: 倒是只有凶神恶煞的句子，才配得上现在这种场合……

en.t: Only savage, threatening words would suit a situation like this...

units.source_text: 要不然的话，他真希望至少在这一钱不值的绝望过程中，别再来打搅自己了……

en.t: Otherwise, he truly wished that at least during this worthless process of despair, no one would disturb him anymore...
